cat > /tmp/count_calls.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
cd /bench/repo

# Check each function
for func in "ValidateEmail" "GenUUID" "HasPrefixes" "ConvertStringToInt32" "ReplaceString" "NewEngine" "DefaultEngine" "NewSchema" "AppendConditions" "NewMarkdownRenderer" "DetectJPEG" "ExtractVideo" "ValidateURL" "GetHTMLMeta" "GetImage" "Post" "PostAsync" "Send" "SendAsync" "NewService" "ParseCronExpression" "DefaultTranscriptionModel" "FindProvider"; do
  # Count occurrences outside of the definition file
  count=$(rg "$func\(" --type go --count-matches | awk '{s+=$1} END {print s}')
  
  # Try to find definition file
  deffile=$(rg "^func \(.*\)?$func\(" --type go -l | grep -v test | head -1)
  
  echo "$func: ~$count calls (defined in $(basename $deffile 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown'))"
done | sort -t: -k2 -rn | head -20
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/count_calls.sh
bash /tmp/count_calls.sh

message.text: Let me refine my search to avoid false matches:

args.command:
cat > /tmp/better_count.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
cd /bench/repo

# Get all functions defined in internal/ (exported)
funcs=$(grep -r "^func [A-Z]" internal/ --include="*.go" | grep -v test | sed 's/.*:func \(.*\)(.*/\1/' | sort -u)

# For each function, count non-test calls (excluding the definition itself)
for func in $funcs; do
  # Skip common ones that have too many false positives
  if [[ "$func" == "New" ]] || [[ "$func" == "Send" ]] || [[ "$func" == "Post" ]]; then
    continue
  fi
  
  # Get the definition location
  def_line=$(grep -r "^func.*$func(" internal/ --include="*.go" | grep -v test | head -1)
  if [ -z "$def_line" ]; then
    continue
  fi
  
  deffile=$(echo "$def_line" | cut -d: -f1)
  
  # Use word boundary matching for more precision
  total=$(grep -rw "$func" . --include="*.go" --exclude="*_test.go" | grep -c "($func\|, $func\|= $func")
  
  # If word boundary matching doesn't work well, try with space or paren
  if [ $total -eq 0 ]; then
    total=$(grep -r "$func(" . --include="*.go" --exclude="*_test.go" | grep -v "^$deffile" | wc -l)
  else
    total=$((total - 1))
  fi
  
  # Only print if there are calls
  if [ $total -gt 2 ]; then
    printf "%-30s %3d calls  %s\n" "$func" "$total" "$deffile"
  fi
done | sort -k2 -rn
EOF
bash /tmp/better_count.sh
